title: SHIPPING PROTECTION & SHIPPING TIE-DOWN SLOTS
summary: Temporary shipping protection put on new cars at the plant: a cover at the door opening sill held by a band, paper/plastic floor mat covers on both floor mats, and a door edge protector on the rear edge of the door, plus rust-proofing oil (15a). Also shows the frame shipping tie-down slots: two at the front under the nose and one each side in the frame rail 17.25 in. from the car's centerline (View A).
